name: Pre-registration
description: Strategy definition frozen in git before results are seen; commit hash is the registration.
threshold: Commit hash recorded before evaluation window

name: Train/validation/holdout split
threshold: validation and final holdout seasons to protect out-of-sample testing.

name: No backtest numbers on leaderboard
description: Backtest numbers forbidden from ever appearing on the leaderboard.

name: Official-source correlations
description: Correlations computed only from officially sourced numbers with n published.

name: Signal vs staking separation
description: Leaderboard separates signal from staking; lucky staking run cannot mask bad signal.

name: Control baselines
description: Every leaderboard run includes random-picks and favorites-only controls.

name: Demotion gate
description: Live strategy sent back to paper when gate fails.

name: Proper-score ranking
description: Rank by benchmark-relative Brier skill with game-cluster lower bound and multiplicity adjustment.

name: Joint-evidence gate (parlays/props)
description: Combo ranked only with a directly validated joint probability and operator void/push rules.
threshold: Joint probability + void rules both present

name: Price-data policy before backtests
description: Price-data policy decided before any backtest is published.

name: Probability + inputs stored
description: Every model output stored as probability plus its inputs

name: Ablations not fixed penalties
description: Injury/personnel ablations compare identical models with and without availability features.
